lede: Benson celebrates Christmas with a Frontier Christmas parade, bus tours of local Christmas lights and trees decorated along 4th Street.
celebrates: The City of Benson leads the season with its Festival of Lights, a Christmas parade with local businesses, schools, families and city departments, followed by a tree lighting, crafts, hot cocoa and a visit with Mr. and Mrs. Claus at City Hall. The recreation department also runs a Christmas Decorating Contest for homes and businesses in the 85602 ZIP Code, bus tours of the lights and a program that lets people decorate trees along 4th Street. Many of the programs ask for a canned food donation for the Benson Community Food Bank.

Because the 2026 celebration is the 15th Annual Festival of Lights, last year's was the 14th. The city's recreation page for 2026 carries the same festival in a new Old West and America's 250th theme.
facts: The 2026 parade theme is A Frontier Christmas: Old West Meets America's 250th. The city reserves the song Santa Claus Is Coming to Town for its own Santa and Mrs. Claus. Kartchner Caverns State Park near Benson posts Christmas Eve hours of 8 am to 2 pm and is closed on Christmas Day, with a park entrance fee of $10 per vehicle for one person, according to Arizona State Parks.
trains: Benson is a Southern Pacific railroad town, and a replica of its original depot now serves as the Benson Visitor Center. Amtrak lists an unstaffed Benson station at 105 East 4th Street, served by the Sunset Limited and the Texas Eagle. In Tucson, the Southern Arizona Transportation Museum shows steam locomotive 1673 in the old Southern Pacific depot, and Old Pueblo Trolley in South Tucson keeps historic streetcars. The Verde Canyon Railroad runs its Magical Christmas Journey in Clarkdale, far to the north.

faq: Does Benson have a Christmas parade?

Yes. The City of Benson holds its Christmas parade as part of the annual Festival of Lights. The 2026 theme is A Frontier Christmas: Old West Meets America's 250th, and the tree lighting follows at City Hall.
Can kids meet Santa in Benson?

Mr. and Mrs. Claus visit City Hall after the parade for the tree lighting, crafts and hot cocoa, according to the city's calendar. The city also reserves the song Santa Claus Is Coming to Town for its own Santa and Mrs. Claus in the parade.
How do the Benson Christmas light tours work?

Riders register online with the recreation department and board a bus at City Hall to see the Christmas lights around the community. Seats are limited, so signing up early is recommended. Snacks and drinks are welcome and alcohol is prohibited.
Is there a train in Benson?

Amtrak's Sunset Limited and Texas Eagle stop at an unstaffed station at 105 East 4th Street. The Benson Visitor Center is a replica of the town's original depot, and Benson is a former Southern Pacific railroad town.
Is Kartchner Caverns open at Christmas?
Arizona State Parks lists Christmas Eve hours of 8 am to 2 pm and says the park is closed on Christmas Day. Check the park's page before you drive, since tours and ticket prices are set by the park.
